description.short: Cited answers from your company's documents, in Teams.
description.full: Ask the Knowledge assistant in a 1:1 chat, or @mention it in a channel or group chat. Answers cite the documents they come from. In a 1:1 chat you're answered from everything your account may see; in channels and group chats only from documents everyone may see. Rate an answer with the thumbs up or down under it.

commands.title: Ask a question
commands.description: For example: What is our refund policy?
